name: India Alliance Early Career Fellowship in Basic Biomedical Research
amount: Up to Rs 2.25 crore total incl. stipend of Rs 1.45 lakh/month (years 1-2) and Rs 1.55 lakh/month (years 3-5)
other_rules: Final-year PhD students or up to 4 years post-PhD at the full-application deadline (counted from viva)
must be based at an Indian host institution
PhD supervisor cannot be the fellowship supervisor
must identify a collaborating group outside the host institution for part of the project (Work Outside Host Institution)
MD/MS/MPH holders may apply for basic biomedical proposals
notes: 2026 round listing closed 16 Mar 2026; next call announced on indiaalliance.org. Process: preliminary application, full application with international review, interview. Stipend only for fellows without host salary. Details from the IndiaBioscience 2026 listing.
